newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-KINGS CENTER PERREAULT HAS KIDNEY SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-KINGS CENTER PERREAULT HAS KIDNEY SURGERY.

text.p: Los Angeles Kings second-year centre Yanic Perreault had successful kidney surgery Friday and was expected to make a full recovery and return to hockey next season, doctors said.
Perreault, 25, underwent pyeloplasty surgery to repair an obstruction causing pressure on his kidney.
Perreault was sixth on the team in scoring with 11 goals and 14 assists in 41 games when the ailment was detected during a magnetic resonance imaging test on February 21.
As a rookie in 1995-96, Perreault had 25 goals and 24 assists in 78 games.
